day.title: Day and time
day.text: One turn of the dial is 12 hours: the sun or moon goes round once before noon (AM) and once after (PM). The centre shows the time in 24-hour form. A day runs from 06:00 to 22:00. Each action uses time. Sleep ends the day. The green ring is your energy.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: Month, week and day. The jam build has 2 months of 4 weeks.

gold.title: Gold
gold.text: Your money. Buy materials and food, pay bills and the debt.

debt.title: Debt
debt.text: The riba loan. Pay the minimum at month end. A short payment adds a late fee.

food.title: Food packs
food.text: Eat up to 3 meals a day for energy. No meal lowers your energy for the next day.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: Work uses energy. Rest, eat and sleep give it back.

todayGoal.title: Today's goal
todayGoal.text: The goal you set for today in the plan. Use one of its stations to meet it.

tabSchedule.title: Daily goals
tabSchedule.text: Drag a goal card onto each day of the week.

tabStore.title: Store plan
tabStore.text: Pick the products to sell and fill the budget jars.

tabLedger.title: Ledger and assets
tabLedger.text: Income, costs and what you own.

tabMarket.title: Market forecast
tabMarket.text: This week's prices and demand trend.

tabHours.title: Public schedule
tabHours.text: Opening hours of each place and this week's events.

tabSkills.title: Skills and level
tabSkills.text: Your skills and what each level gives you.

tabNotes.title: Notes and objectives
tabNotes.text: Your notes from last week and the game objectives.

tabLog.title: Log
tabLog.text: What you did today and before.

goalDeck.title: Goal cards
goalDeck.text: Drag a card onto a day. Or click a card, then click a day. Drag a day card back here to clear it.

goalMet.title: Goal met
goalMet.text: A goal is met when you use one of its stations that day. Each met goal gives XP.

products.title: Products to sell
products.text: How many units you plan to sell this week. This sets the store goal and the materials.

materials.title: Materials needed
materials.text: What the products need. Buy the missing ones at the market or the guild. Dried and powder come from the rack and the grinder.

jarStore.title: Store jar
jarStore.text: Gold for materials and store costs this week.

jarPersonal.title: Personal jar
jarPersonal.text: Gold for food and your own needs this week.

jarBuffer.title: Buffer jar
jarBuffer.text: Gold you keep safe for bills and the debt. Try not to spend it.

goldAfter.title: Gold after plan
goldAfter.text: An estimate: gold now, minus planned costs, plus 80% of planned sales.

warnings.title: Plan check
warnings.text: Problems in the plan. They do not block you.

reviewPlan.title: Review plan
reviewPlan.text: See the plan totals, then start the week.

trend.title: Demand trend
trend.text: Up: more customers want it this week. Down: fewer.

priceRange.title: Price range
priceRange.text: The usual price range. The price changes each week inside it.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.text: A place is closed outside its hours. Early arrival waits at the door.

skillMoon.title: Moon
skillMoon.text: Craft and process. A higher level makes better quality products.

skillSun.title: Sun
skillSun.text: Sell and trade. A higher level brings more customers.

skillEarth.title: Earth
skillEarth.text: Gather. A higher level finds more loot.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.text: The notes you picked at the end of last week.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.text: Small steps to learn the game. They tick when you do them.

town.title: Town
town.text: Open the place list. Pick a place, then Go. Travel uses time and energy.
